title: Discovery to approved brief
summary: Establish intent, calculate the VLD plan, then hand a bounded product brief to an agent or reviewer.

steps.description: Confirm the profile's users, problem, non-goals and risk flags before any generated artifact is trusted.
Calculate and review the deterministic VLD plan.
Draft a product brief without changing policy, tier, requirements or acceptance evidence.
A responsible human accepts, revises or rejects the brief before architecture and delivery work begin.
